item.title: More Help for PMETs Retrenched in 2018

attempt.title: More Help for PMETs Retrenched in 2018
attempt.what_it_is: More Help for PMETs Retrenched in 2018

sections.label: PMET retrenchment and vacancies
sections.summary: In 2018 about 5,400 local PMETs were retrenched, the lowest since 2014, with 0.8% long-term unemployment and about 31,500 PMET vacancies.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In 2018, about 5,400 local professionals, managers, executives and technicians (PMETs) were retrenched, the lowest level since 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The resident long-term unemployment rate for PMETs, an indicator of structural unemployment, remained low at 0.8%.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: At present, there are also about 31,500 vacancies for PMETs.

sections.label: Retrenchment benefits survey 2017
sections.summary: Based on the 2017 survey, around 90% of retrenching establishments paid retrenchment benefits, slightly higher than in 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Based on the 2017 survey on retrenchment benefits, around 90% of retrenching establishments paid retrenchment benefits to their workers, slightly higher than in 2016.

sections.label: PMET retrenchments and job placements
sections.summary: Nearly two-thirds of 2018 PMET retrenchments were in restructuring sectors, about seven in 10 assisted workers found jobs within six months, and about 17,000 PMETs were placed.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Nearly two-thirds of PMET retrenchments in 2018 were in sectors undergoing restructuring, namely, Wholesale Trade, Financial and Insurance Services, Information and Communications and Professional Services sectors.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: About seven in 10 of retrenched workers who accepted assistance by the Taskforce found new jobs within six months.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: About 17,000 PMETs were placed last year, nearly double that in 2016.

sections.label: Career Support Programme extension
sections.summary: The Career Support Programme will be extended for two years to provide salary support to employers hiring long-term unemployed or retrenched mature PMETs.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: As announced at the Budget this year, we will extend the Career Support Programme for two years to continue providing salary support to employers who hire long-term unemployed or retrenched mature PMETs.
